info.title: session-ir
info.summary: Replays the commands an adapter lifted from a transcript and holds the resulting session state.
info.description:
The HTTP surface of `session-ir`, one of the components of `sessionspec` v1.

Every path here is one semantic command, so the method is always POST and the path is the command's wire name under its domain's: a command is not a resource, and this document does not invent one. A status code is the outcome the specification declares — 202 for a branch that was taken, 422 for a refusal the input decides, 502 for a refusal decided outside the request — and the `outcome` property of every response body names the branch. This component publishes `AgentEnded`, `AgentStarted`, `ContextCompacted`, `ExposureDetected`, `ModelTurnRecorded`, `PromptSubmitted`, `SessionEnded`, `SessionOpened`, `ToolCallCompleted`, `ToolCallDecided`, `ToolCallRequested` and `TurnEnded` to consumers through the event transport; an event a branch emits that is not among them stays inside the component. The `published` property of every response body lists every event its branch emitted, in the order it emits them, published or not.

The specification declares who may invoke what (`x-ess-may-invoke` on each operation), so every command is sent as a declared actor. How a request proves which actor it is belongs to the realization, which authenticates it and hands the surface the caller; nothing in the request itself names one. The grant is checked before the command runs, and a request authenticated as no actor, or as one without the grant, is answered 403 with one standard refusal, the same for every command: `{"refused": "not granted", "actor": <name or null>}`. A 403 a declared branch answers carries `outcome` and the declared `error` instead, so a client tells the two apart by the members present. A command no declared actor may invoke is refused to every caller. A view an actor's grant names is read-checked the same way (`x-ess-may-read` on its operation): a request authenticated as no actor, or as one the grant does not name, is answered 403 with the same standard refusal before the view is read. A view no grant names is open, and any caller may read what it publishes.

This component declares `reached_by: network`, so its callers are not deployed with it and this contract is the surface they reach it through. That declaration is also why the views its domains declare have paths here: a GET under `views` per projection, answering every row it holds. There is no page size, no cursor, no ordering and no filter parameter, because the specification states none — a view's filter is part of the projection, not of the request. A view that declares `params:` is the exception: each is a query parameter, described on its operation, and a view that declares `paging:` takes its page and size there.

tags.name: session
tags.description: An agent session of any harness, as actors issuing commands. An adapter lifts a vendor transcript into these commands; replaying them yields the events and the state the KPIs read. Content is never held: a prompt, a tool input or a tool output is a digest and a length.

202.description: Outcome `compacted`: the branch the specification declares for this input. Events this branch emits are published to consumers and listed under `published`.

403.description: No declared outcome: the standard refusal for an actor no grant admits: the request was authenticated as no actor, or as one `x-ess-may-invoke` does not list. It is checked before the command runs, so nothing was read, written or published, and the same request from a granted actor is decided by the command. Its body carries `refused` and `actor`, never the `outcome` and `error` a declared branch carries.

actor.description: The qualified name of the actor the request was authenticated as, or null where it was authenticated as none.

refused.description: The standard refusal for an actor no grant admits.

404.description: Outcome `no-such-agent`: the branch the specification declares for this input. Events this branch emits are published to consumers and listed under `published`.

501.description: No declared outcome: the realization is unfinished. Either a port this command runs reported an unmet obligation, and nothing was written: `committed` is `false`. Or the command's effect was committed and delivering what this command published to a binding failed: `committed` is `true`, the effect and its events stand, and each binding whose delivery failed keeps its event and is attempted again on a later delivery, while no other binding receives it twice. Do not retry: after a failed delivery a retry performs the command a second time.

committed.description: `true` when the command's effect and events were committed and delivering what it published failed; `false` when an unmet obligation stopped the command before anything was written.

sessionspec.session.CompactContext.compa.description: The context was replaced by a summary; the next model turn writes the cache again. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `sessionspec.session.Agent` has changed, and its state is unchanged. The instance is the one `agent_id` names. Emits `ContextCompacted`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

session_hash.description: The gateway's name of the session: SHA-256 of `llm-gateway.session/1\0<source>\0<header value>`, its first 6 bytes as 12 hex digits. Both sources compute it, so they join.

sessionspec.session.OpenSession.opened.R.description: The session exists and holds no agent yet. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `sessionspec.session.Session` now exists, in `Open`. Its identity is published as `session_id` on `sessionspec.session.SessionOpened`. Emits `SessionOpened`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

sessionspec.session.PromptAuthor.title: PromptAuthor
sessionspec.session.PromptAuthor.description: Who wrote a prompt. Delegate is a session acting for the human; Harness covers task notifications, compaction summaries and auto-continuation.

sessionspec.session.PromptClass.title: PromptClass
sessionspec.session.PromptClass.description: What a prompt asks, from rules over its text run on the host before redaction; Unknown when no rule matched or the author is the harness or a hook.

sessionspec.session.RecordExposure.Input.title: Record an exposure input
sessionspec.session.RecordExposure.Input.description: The redaction pass found a secret or a personal datum and replaced it.

sessionspec.session.RecordExposure.recor.description: The exposure is on record under its alias; the value is not. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `sessionspec.session.Exposure` now exists, in `Recorded`. Its identity is published as `exposure_id` on `sessionspec.session.ExposureDetected`. Emits `ExposureDetected`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

sessionspec.session.RecordModelTurn.Inpu.title: Record a model turn input
sessionspec.session.RecordModelTurn.Inpu.description: One model message of the agent, with the model that wrote it and its token usage.

message_id.description: The id the provider gave the answer (`msg_…`, `chatcmpl-…`, `resp_…`); both sources hold it, so they join on it.

call_id.description: The gateway's call id (`x-llm-gateway-call`), the pointer to its call record. Wire only.

ttft_ms.description: Milliseconds from the request to the first answer byte.

declared_cost_microdollars.description: Token counts times the price the gateway's owner declares for the route; absent on a route without one. Not a provider's bill.

sessionspec.session.RecordModelTurn.no-s.description: Taken when the request names an identity no record carries.

error.description: No agent of this identity was started; the adapter lost a StartAgent.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

sessionspec.session.RecordModelTurn.reco.description: The agent's model and context size are those of this message. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `sessionspec.session.Agent` has changed, and its state is unchanged. The instance is the one `agent_id` names. Emits `ModelTurnRecorded`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

cwd.description: The working directory of the call, relative to the home directory as `~/…`.

background.description: The agent asked for the call to run in the background and went on.

sessionspec.session.RequestToolCall.requ.description: The tool call waits for a decision. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `sessionspec.session.ToolCall` now exists, in `Requested`. Its identity is published as `tool_call_id` on `sessionspec.session.ToolCallRequested`. Emits `ToolCallRequested`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

sessionspec.session.SessionStateConflict.title: SessionStateConflict payload
sessionspec.session.SessionStateConflict.description: The session is not in a state this command acts from.

rows.description: Every row the projection holds, in the order it holds them.

sessionspec.session.Source.title: Source
sessionspec.session.Source.description: Where a record was observed: a harness transcript on disk, or a model call on a gateway's wire (`docs/interaction-records.md`).

spawned_by.description: The tool call of the parent that started this agent, when the harness records it.

sessionspec.session.StartAgent.started.R.description: The agent exists and is Idle until its first prompt. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `sessionspec.session.Agent` now exists, in `Idle`. Its identity is published as `agent_id` on `sessionspec.session.AgentStarted`. Emits `AgentStarted`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

sessionspec.session.SubmitPrompt.Input.title: Submit a prompt input
sessionspec.session.SubmitPrompt.Input.description: A prompt reaches an agent. From Idle it starts a turn; while Working it is queued into the running turn, as Claude Code does with a message typed mid-turn.

sessionspec.session.SubmitPrompt.submitt.description: The agent is Working on the prompt. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `sessionspec.session.Agent` has moved to `Working`, along `resume`. The instance is the one `agent_id` names. Emits `PromptSubmitted`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

sessionspec.session.SubmitPrompt.wrong-s.description: The agent had ended, so the prompt reached nobody. Taken when the subject is in a state none of this command's declared moves start from. Which states those are is the lifecycle's answer, not this command's. For an instance no record carries, `payload` is absent, because an instance that does not exist has nothing for the error to describe.

error.description: The agent is not in a state this command acts from.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

sessionspec.session.ToolCallId.title: ToolCallId
sessionspec.session.ToolCallId.description: The harness's identifier of one tool call.

sessionspec.session.ToolCallStateConflic.title: ToolCallStateConflict payload
sessionspec.session.ToolCallStateConflic.description: The tool call is not in a state this command acts from.

rows.description: Every row the projection holds, in the order it holds them.

sessionspec.session.UnknownAgent.Error.title: UnknownAgent payload
sessionspec.session.UnknownAgent.Error.description: No agent of this identity was started; the adapter lost a StartAgent.

sessionspec.session.Usage.title: Usage
sessionspec.session.Usage.description: Token usage of one model message, as the harness reports it.

sessionspec.session.Verdict.title: Verdict
sessionspec.session.Verdict.description: Ok is a known fixture or allowed value, Gap a confirmed exposure, Unk a match nobody confirmed.

sessionspec.session.Agent.title: Agent
sessionspec.session.Agent.description: One agent loop. Working while its turn runs, Idle once the turn ended and until the next prompt. Idle time before a human prompt is time the session waited on the human.

sessionspec.session.AgentId.title: AgentId
sessionspec.session.AgentId.description: One agent loop in a session; the main loop or a sub-agent.

sessionspec.session.AgentRole.title: AgentRole
sessionspec.session.AgentRole.description: SideCall is a model call of the harness outside every agent's conversation (a title, a summary, a quota probe): the wire tells it by a call with no tools and no history.

sessionspec.session.Exposure.title: Exposure
sessionspec.session.Exposure.description: A secret or a personal datum the redaction pass found in one channel of one agent. Holds the class, the detector kind and a per-session alias; never the value.

sessionspec.session.ExposureChannel.title: ExposureChannel
sessionspec.session.ExposureChannel.description: Where a secret or a personal datum appeared. ToolInput is the severe one when the tool's category is Network, Message or Execute: the value left the session.

sessionspec.session.ExposureId.title: ExposureId
sessionspec.session.ExposureId.description: One finding of the redaction pass; the adapter mints it from the record and the match position.

sessionspec.session.Session.title: Session
sessionspec.session.Session.description: One harness session, from its first record to its last.

sessionspec.session.ToolCall.title: ToolCall
sessionspec.session.ToolCall.description: One tool call an agent requested, the decision on it and its result.

sessionspec.session.ToolCallId.title: ToolCallId
sessionspec.session.ToolCallId.description: The harness's identifier of one tool call.

sessionspec.session.Verdict.title: Verdict
sessionspec.session.Verdict.description: Ok is a known fixture or allowed value, Gap a confirmed exposure, Unk a match nobody confirmed.
